articles.title: What Liberal Arts Education Is for (2024)
articles.summary: A college course on The Letters of Paul, which was taken for fun and intellectual challenge, turned out to be more than just reading about ancient texts. articles.title: Elevators
articles.summary: The simplest elevator algorithm is called SCAN and was patented in 1961, which starts at the lobby and goes all the way to the top floor before reversing and coming back down, picking up and dropping off anyone along the way. Most of the time you don't actually need to go to the top floor if the elevator only goes as high as requested before reversing. This is known as the LOOK algorithm, which assigns requests to the closest elevator based on proximity. However, in a real-world scenario with multiple elevators and complex traffic patterns, this can lead to long waits for some passengers. Researchers have found that by analyzing wait times using metrics such as "wait < 30s" or "wait < 90s", they can identify areas where the algorithm is struggling, such as during peak morning rush hours when nearly all traffic is concentrated at the lobby and upper levels.

This allows for backgrounding processes without losing control over them, as the parent process can still interact with the child process through its controlling terminal. The technique involves creating a new process using fork and then setting it as the session leader using setsid, which creates a new session that removes the controlling terminal. This allows for efficient backgrounding of processes while maintaining control over them.
